name: efficiency
notes: replay mode. Latency is measured only in replay, from the live latency each cassette stores; an answer with an older recording (no latency) leaves its group's latency not measured. Latency measured on 60 of 60 answers. 0 answers with a failed or unrecorded model step are left out of every statistic.
Where latency is not measured, `latency_estimated_*` counts each unmeasured call at its tier's measured median call latency; it is an estimate and decides no target.
End-to-end = local time in replay + each step's model wait (concurrent judge calls overlap) − the Understand/prefetch overlap. Network and server time outside Mesh calls are not included.

targets.label: Time to first progress step, p95 (s)
